list.q: Is FormShield officially affiliated with DigiLocker?
list.a: FormShield integrates with DigiLocker using standard OAuth 2.0 Partner API specifications under the Digital India initiative. All documents are digitally signed and verified directly from source issuing authorities (UIDAI, Income Tax Dept, State Education Boards).

Yes. Documents fetched via DigiLocker are treated at par with original physical documents under Rule 9A of the Information Technology (Preservation and Retention of Information by Intermediaries Providing Digital Locker Facilities) Rules, 2016.

list.q: Does FormShield store my private Aadhaar or biometric data?
list.a: No. FormShield strictly complies with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023. Document data is extracted purely for form population and session memory. We do not store your Aadhaar biometric records or sell citizen data.

list.q: How much does it cost to use FormShield?
list.a: FormShield is free for citizen pre-submission checks. Official government processing fees (if applicable for your specific scheme) are paid directly to the respective State Government or Portal.
